code_or_query:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(10,4))
ax1.set_title('Cross-section at midspan (looking along span)')
ax1.plot([-3,3],[2,2], linewidth=3)
ax1.plot([-2.2,-2.2],[2,0.2], linewidth=3)
ax1.plot([2.2,2.2],[2,0.2], linewidth=3)
ax1.plot([-2.2,2.2],[1.2,1.2], linewidth=2)
for x in [-1.1, 1.1]:
    ax1.plot([x,x],[1.2,0.5], linestyle='--')
    ax1.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((x-0.35,0.0),0.7,0.5))
    ax1.text(x,0.25,'TMD', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8)
ax1.text(0,2.15,'deck (clear)', ha='center', fontsize=8)
ax1.text(-2.2,1.1,'girder', ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax1.set_xlim(-3.5,3.5); ax1.set_ylim(-0.5,2.8); ax1.set_aspect('equal'); ax1.axis('off')
ax2.set_title('Side view along 40m span')
ax2.plot([0,40],[2,2], linewidth=3)
ax2.plot([0,40],[1.0,1.0], linewidth=1, linestyle=':')
ax2.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((17,0.2),2.2,0.8))
ax2.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((20.8,0.2),2.2,0.8))
ax2.plot([17,19.2],[1.4,1.4]); ax2.plot([20.8,23],[1.4,1.4])
ax2.text(18.1,0.6,'TMD1', ha='center', fontsize=8)
ax2.text(21.9,0.6,'TMD2', ha='center', fontsize=8)
ax2.text(20,2.15,'midspan zone', ha='center', fontsize=8)
ax2.text(20,1.55,'springs+dampers to cross beam', ha='center', fontsize=7)
ax2.set_xlim(0,40); ax2.set_ylim(-0.5,2.8); ax2.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('sketch.png', dpi=120)
